// ATTEMPT 14: SEND NOTHING, MINT A THROWAWAY, AND THE HANDLE OPENS EVERYBODY'S.
//
// Every other attack needs the class to hold one of its own responses. This one removes the
// precondition: a class that has sent NOTHING calls the exported package-level minter with the
// run id it already has from ctx.Route.Obs().RunID, gets a handle into the run's shared vault,
// and reflects through it. The audit ran this and it returned every class's body.
//
// The package-level minter is gone. Nothing outside tests called it, and a package-level entry
// point that resolves a run by id is the same shape of hole as the run registry that //go:linkname
// reached. The runner holds its own vault from NewPerturbedVault, which takes the capability.
package leakfixture

import "ars0n-framework-v2-server/utils/triage"

func leakMintYourOwnWayIn(ctx triage.ClassifyCtx) (triage.Perturbed, error) {
	runID := ctx.Route.Obs().RunID
	return triage.NewPerturbed(
		triage.Observation{RunID: runID, Kind: triage.ObsProbe, Class: triage.ClassExample},
		triage.ClassExample, "THROWAWAY-1", uint64(triage.ClassExample), "")
}
